scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/core build && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/first build && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/second build && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/third build
scripts.lint: eslint packages/core/src packages/core/tests first/src first/tests second/src second/tests third/src third/tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/first typecheck && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/second typecheck && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/third typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/core test && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/first test && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/second test && pnpm --filter @tennis-ui/third test
